Introduction
This document 
outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on yearly bases or 
during outage of service as indicated by Y1 in the above title block..
Technical Specifications:
For 220 kv Switchyard Surge Arrestor

For 500 kv Switchyard Surge Arrestor

The 
first draft initiated by eng.
Amged Abd El Aziz, tested by eng. Wageh Khalil, revised by MDEPC 
quality control eng. Adel El Naggar, accepted by general manager eng Ali Zahran, approved by 
eng Ahmed Sawan head sector of Nubaria Power Station.
This document certified by eng. Samir Abd El Gillil MDEPC 
 quality control general manager and MPIS coordinator and approved by eng. 
 Mohammed Nageb quality control head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the 
 suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area,
Wear appropriate personal protective equipment must be used, safety shoes, 
 helmet breathing mask, safety glasses
Circuit breaker must be fully isolated
Earthing switch must be closed on both sides of the breaker
The circuit breaker should be switched off and ground the CB on both sides.
Isolation and proper earthing is required.
There is danger of falling off the top of the arrester when cleaning 
 insulators or checking connections, wear your safety belt.
Tools 
and Equipment
Tester (digital Avometer).
Set off spanners and screw drivers .
Oscillograph.
500/1000 V Megger .
Vacuum cleaner.
Safety belt, and safety Helmet
Rags
Work to be 
carried out
Check porcelain for cracks, and chipped skirts.
Check for loose caps and tighten if necessary.
Thoroughly clean all porcelain surfaces
Setting
Check for loose caps and tighten if 
 necessary.
